en: A ONE-DAY STEP (15 Sep 2026). The previous scan is 14 Sep, so every comparison in this file is against 14 Sep. The GSC window advanced to 16 Aug-12 Sep and the GA4 window to 18 Aug-14 Sep.
Read directly from Chrome: GSC, GA4, the Ahrefs web UI, Brand Radar, and a full 109-page crawl against the origin itself. No OpenSEO, no Supermetrics, no Ahrefs API.

SPEED IMPROVED AGAIN. Site-wide mean TTFB fell 571 -> 350 ms and the median 533 -> 287 ms in a single day; 96 of 108 comparable pages are faster and only 12 slower. All 109 pages are under one second for a second consecutive day. The slowest page is still the /articles hub at 920 ms.

GSC barely moved: clicks 46 -> 46, CTR 3.5% -> 3.5%, average position 30.8 -> 30.8. Impressions 1,333 -> 1,318 (summed row by row from the 28 DAYS rows) and queries 98 -> 95, both easing because the window slid one day.
Brand still carries all of search: dxliving 22 + dx living 17 = 39 of 46 clicks (84.8%). All 17 page-one queries are brand terms. Every non-brand query in the 95-row table is still on zero clicks.

THE CLOSEST NON-BRAND QUERY SLIPPED AGAIN: '3d renders for builders melbourne' 12.6 -> 13.1 with impressions 51 -> 47. The other Melbourne queries were essentially static. The Adelaide cluster is still down to two queries at 38.0 and 42.0.

ONE NEW ARTICLE: digital-twin-construction-australia (2,095 words). Sitemap 109 -> 110 URLs, 85 -> 86 articles. The hub links it on the first read and it returns 200 with exactly one H1, a canonical and a meta description.

But the new article AGAIN ships without FAQPage schema, like the three published on 14 Sep. FAQPage coverage fell 76.5% -> 75.6%. This is a publishing-template fault, not a content fault, and it is the cheapest item on this list to fix.

GA4 rose with the window: 614 sessions (+19), 3,150 events, 365 users; Direct 215, Organic Search 196, Organic Social 192, AI Assistant 9. Organic Search carries 5 of the 7 key events at 66.84% engagement and 1m 37s.

GOOD NEWS ON 7-DAY VOLUME: 110 -> 116 sessions week on week (+5.5%), reversing two consecutive weeks of decline. But there were ZERO key events in BOTH 7-day windows, the TENTH consecutive scan - all 7 key events in the 28-day window predate 31 Aug.
Facebook (176 sessions across four source rows) is now the site's largest traffic source. Organic Social engages at just 25% with a 4-SECOND average engagement time and no key events at all.
Ahrefs: DR 0 and UR 0 unchanged. Referring domains 338 -> 345 and backlinks 368 -> 376 in one day; only 41 domains (11.9%) and 44 links (11.7%) are followed, which is why DR stays pinned at 0.

AI visibility holds at 30/100 for a NINTH scan. AI responses 21 and cited pages 10 are unchanged (ChatGPT 12/5, Copilot 8/6, Perplexity 1/1). Google AI Overviews and AI Mode are still zero. Brand Radar 'Dxliving' still tracks 0 prompts - a 21st reading.

The Ahrefs Site Audit crawl ran today at 04:23 AM: Health 100% but on only 13 URLs (down from 15). That figure does NOT describe an 86-article site; use the 109-page crawl in technical_health instead.

THE /articles OVERLAY IS INTO DAY 19. A fixed full-viewport div still covers the hub and elementFromPoint at the centre returns BODY. Crawlers are unaffected (the server HTML links all 86 articles) but HUMAN readers are not.
GSC Page indexing is still dated 4 Sep - a ninth reading. Indexed 87 / not indexed 119 and all eight reasons are unchanged, so it does not yet reflect the recent articles.
Google last read the sitemap on 13 Sep with 109 pages, while the live sitemap now declares 110 URLs. The one-URL gap is exactly the article published after that read - no action needed yet.
